sections.shortTitle: Northern Areas Court of Appeals Establishment Order 1999
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

NORTHERN AREAS COURT OF APPEALS (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER, 1999
NORTHERN AREAS
COURT OF APPEALS (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER, 1999
An Order to provide
for the establishment of the Court of Appeals for Northern Areas
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 11, 8th November, 1999]
S.R.O. 1170(1)/99, dated
28-10-1999.--Whereas it is expedient to provide for the establishment of the
Court of Appeals for Areas and to provide for certain incidental and ancillary
matters;
Now, therefore, the Government of
Pakistan is pleased to make the following Order:--
1. Short title extent and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Northern Areas Court of
Appeals (Establishment) Order, 1999. ,
(2) It extends to the whole of
Northern Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Appointment of Chairman and Members

NORTHERN AREAS COURT OF APPEALS (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER, 1999

COURT OF APPEALS (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER, 1999
An Order to provide
for the establishment of the Court of Appeals for Northern Areas
[Gazette of

S.R.O. 1170(1)/99, dated
28-10-1999.--Whereas it is expedient to provide for the establishment of the
Court of Appeals for Areas and to provide for certain incidental and ancillary
matters;
Now, therefore, the Government of
Pakistan is pleased to make the following Order:--
5. Appointment of Chairman and
Members.--(1) The Chairman and Members shall be appointed by the Government
for a fix term not exceeding three years and may be appointed for such further
term or terms or part of term as the Government may determine.
(2) A person shall not be appointed
as Chairman unless he has been a Judge of a High Court or is qualified to be a
member.
(3) A person shall not be
appointed a member unless he is not less than forty years of age and---
(a) has for a period of, or for
periods aggregating not less than fifteen years practised law as an Advocate in
the Northern Areas or in any part of Pakistan or
(b) has for a period of not less
than fifteen years held a judicial office.

Now, therefore, the Government of

6. Resignation and Removal.--(1)
The Chairman or a member may resign his office by writing under his hand
addressed to , the Government.
(2) The Government may remove the
Chairman or a member if the Committee consisting of the Secretary, Ministry of
Law, Justice and Human Rights, Secretary, Ministry of Kashmir Affairs and
Northern Areas and States and Frontier Regions, and the Chief Executive of the
Northern Areas reports that the Chairman or, as the case may be, a member is
guilty of misconduct.

sections.shortTitle: Northern Areas Court of Appeals Establishment Order 1999
sections.description:
Jurisdiction

NORTHERN AREAS COURT OF APPEALS (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER, 1999
NORTHERN AREAS
COURT OF APPEALS (ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER, 1999
An Order to provide
for the establishment of the Court of Appeals for Northern Areas
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 11, 8th November, 1999]
S.R.O. 1170(1)/99, dated
28-10-1999.--Whereas it is expedient to provide for the establishment of the
Court of Appeals for Areas and to provide for certain incidental and ancillary
matters;
Now, therefore, the Government of
Pakistan is pleased to make the following Order:--
9. Jurisdiction.--(1) The
Court of Appeals shall have jurisdiction to hear and determine appeals from
judgments, decrees, final orders of sentences of the Chief Court of Northern
Areas.
(2) All appeals shall be heard by
the Chairman and the Members.
(3) If at any time the office of
the Chairman or a Member is vacant, or, he is absent or unable to perform his
functions of his office due to any cause, appeals may be heard by the Chairman
and one Member or, as the case may be, by two Members.
(4) Where there is difference of
opinion in a case heard under subsection (3) it shall be heard when the third
member or, as the case may be, the Chairman becomes available.
(5) Where it is necessary the
Government may appoint any person, qualified for appointment as member, as an
ad hoc member for disposal of any particular case.
(6) The Government may confer
jurisdiction on the Court of Appeals in respect of such other matters as it
may, from time to time, determine.
